import { guardNoticeRead, type NoticeReadGuard } from './notice-read-guard';
import type { ApiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ClientError } from '../api/errors';
import {
  CommunityController,
  initialCommunityView,
  type CommunityView,
} from '../community/controller';
import type { CommunityRuntime } from '../community/runtime';
import {
  decodeStudentNotices,
  decodeStudentNoticeTarget,
  studentUuid,
  type StudentNotice,
} from '../verification/student-contract';
interface StudentNoticesView extends CommunityView {
  readonly items: readonly StudentNotice[];
  readonly loaded: boolean;
  readonly canMore: boolean;
}
const initial = (): StudentNoticesView => ({
  ...initialCommunityView(),
  items: [],
  loaded: false,
  canMore: false,
});
/** Read-only listing plus explicit per-notice read. No verification mutation capability. */
export class StudentNoticesReader extends CommunityController<StudentNoticesView> {
  private page = 0;
  constructor(
    runtime: CommunityRuntime,
    private readonly api: ApiClient | undefined,
    render: (view: StudentNoticesView) => void,
  ) {
    super(runtime, initial, render);
  }
  protected override resetPrivate(): void {
    this.page = 0;
  }
  protected override onSafetyInvalidated(): void {
    void this.load();
  }
  async load(): Promise<void> {
    this.stop();
    this.page = 0;
    this.update({ items: [], loaded: false, canMore: false, busy: false });
    await this.fetch(false);
  }
  async more(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.view.busy && this.view.canMore) await this.fetch(true);
  }
  private async fetch(append: boolean): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.available()) return;
    if (!this.api) {
      this.update({ error: '认证消息暂不可用', configured: false });
      return;
    }
    const page = append ? this.page + 1 : 1;
    await this.run(
      (cancel) =>
        this.api!.request(
          {
            path: '/v1/me/student-verification/notices',
            method: 'GET',
            authentication: 'required',
            authReplay: 'once',
            successStatus: 200,
            decode: decodeStudentNotices,
          },
          { query: { page }, cancellation: cancel },
        ),
      (result) => {
        if (result.page !== page)
          throw new ClientError('protocol', 'Notice page mismatch');
        const items = new Map(
          (append ? this.view.items : []).map((item) => [item.id, item]),
        );
        for (const item of result.items) items.set(item.id, item);
        this.page = page;
        this.update({
          items: [...items.values()],
          loaded: true,
          canMore: result.hasNext,
        });
      },
      () => {
        this.page = 0;
        this.update({ items: [], loaded: false, canMore: false });
      },
    );
  }
  async open(
    id: string,
    navigate: (url: string) => Promise<void>,
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (
      !this.api ||
      !this.available() ||
      this.view.busy ||
      !this.view.items.some((item) => item.id === id && item.available)
    )
      return;
    await this.run(
      async (cancel) => {
        const result = await this.api!.request(
          {
            path: `/v1/me/student-verification/notices/${studentUuid(id)}/target`,
            method: 'GET',
            authentication: 'required',
            authReplay: 'once',
            successStatus: 200,
            decode: decodeStudentNoticeTarget,
          },
          { cancellation: cancel },
        );
        this.runtime.sessions.assertCurrent(this.owner);
        if (cancel.isCancelled || result.status !== 'available') return;
        const page = result.target.regionId
          ? 'student-verification-review'
          : 'student-verification';
        await navigate(
          `/pages/${page}/${page}?applicationId=${result.target.applicationId}${result.target.regionId ? `&regionId=${result.target.regionId}` : ''}`,
        );
      },
      () => undefined,
    );
  }
  async acknowledge(id: string, guard?: NoticeReadGuard): Promise<void> {
    if (
      !this.api ||
      !this.available() ||
      this.view.busy ||
      !this.view.items.some((item) => item.id === id && !item.read)
    )
      return;
    let settled = false;
    await this.run(
      (cancel) =>
        this.api!.request(
          {
            path: `/v1/me/student-verification/notices/${studentUuid(id)}/read`,
            method: 'POST',
            authentication: 'required',
            authReplay: 'never',
            successStatus: 200,
            decode: decodeStudentNoticeTarget,
          },
          { body: {}, cancellation: guardNoticeRead(cancel, guard) },
        ),
      () => {
        settled = true;
      },
      () => this.update({ items: [], loaded: false, canMore: false }),
    );
    if (settled) await this.load();
  }
  override cancel(): void {
    super.cancel();
    this.page = 0;
    this.update({ items: [], loaded: false, canMore: false });
  }
}
